thread:
alex: Heads up, alerting spikes since 15:10 — oncall didn't get paged for 3 alerts. Incidentbot shows retries but PagerDuty not receiving deliveries.
sara: I can confirm no pages to PD from ~15:11-15:20 in the logs.
incident-bot: detected 6 failed deliveries to pagerduty service; reason=HTTP 429 Throttle. automatic_retries=3 attempted.
maria: ops_oncall, did you see anything?
ops_oncall: I didn't get any page. Only Slack thread. Checked phone, no SMS.
sara: pulling deliverer logs now. attaching snippet:
```
2026-03-17T15:12:05Z ERROR deliver/pagerflow.go: request failed status=429 body='{"error":"rate_limited"}' headers={"Retry-After":null,"X-RateLimit-Burst":"50"}
2026-03-17T15:12:06Z WARN  deliver/pagerflow.go: no retry-after header present, using backoff default
2026-03-17T15:13:20Z INFO  deliver/queue.go: queued retry attempt=2 target=pagerduty
```
alex: Looks like PagerDuty started rejecting due to throttling. But incident-bot metadata shows we were sending with X-RateLimit-Burst=200 last week, now header is 50 — mismatch with adapter config. Anyone touched pagerflow rate config?
devops-bot: deploy bot: there was a config roll 15:03 that applied a global rate-limit patch to ext-connectors (rolled by infra-team).
sara: that patch reduced burst by mistake (global default=50) and pagerflow wasn't exempted.
alex: ops, can you manually page affected oncall while we fix? I'll do manual SMS. :phone:
ops_oncall: got manual SMS, thanks. acknowledging.
maria: quick mitigation idea: toggle throttle override for pagerflow to bypass for critical routes. I'm drafting a hotfix.
alex: what's the risk?
maria: small - it's per-connector flag, we can set `disable_throttle=true` for pagerflow for 15m.
sara: logs show incident-bot still attempted retries but our adapter interpreted missing Retry-After differently; PD returned 429 with no Retry-After header which our client expected. That caused immediate drop instead of exponential backoff. need to make client tolerant.
incident-bot: applying temporary override per request header `X-Disable-Throttle: true` allowed 5 manual deliveries to PD during test.
alex: Maria, apply override. devops-bot, can you approve a short window?
devops-bot: Approved. Pushing env flag now.
(maria sets override)
incident-bot: now seeing 12 successful deliveries to pagerduty in last 2m.
ops_oncall: I received 4 pages that were missing earlier.
sara: mitigation working. Recording customer impact: support spike - two customers reported delayed remediation; internal ticket INC-1234 created. Estimated delay ~4-7 minutes.
alex: Good. Postmortem actions: 1) revert global rate-change and add per-connector exemptions; 2) make PD client accept missing Retry-After (fallback to polite backoff); 3) add synthetic e2e test that sends a page and validates PD delivery on deploy; 4) alert if incidentbot retry_count > 2 and no PD ack within 120s.
maria: I'll open PR for client fallback and a one-line hotpatch to env config.
sara: I created INC-1234 and added logs. Also adding retrospective note to config change playbook.
devops-bot: Rollback of global rate patch scheduled in 10m.
alex: Thanks all. Keeping thread open for follow-up. Please add any customer comments to INC-1234. :memo:
ops_oncall: closing once rollback verified.
incident-bot: summary: root cause=global rate-limit patch unintentionally lowered burst for pagerflow; combined with PD returning 429 without Retry-After header, our client dropped retries. mitigation=temporary disable_throttle flag + rollback scheduled. next steps=follow-up PRs and tests.
